sample: Same 720 fit pairs as prior benchmark: 60 per variant, 30 within/30 across, twelve ReLU variants (one/two units; three architectures; two decoder bias conditions).
benchmark: Actual production align_rnns; include deepcopy, parameter extraction, grid search, refinement and applying transformations; exclude loading, warm-up and quality reports. One CPU core and single-thread BLAS/PyTorch. Config order rotated/reversed.

solvers.trf: Analytic-Jacobian least squares; log bounds [-20,20], ftol/xtol/gtol 1e-10, max_nfev 300.
solvers.L-BFGS-B: Analytic-gradient scalar objective 0.5*sum(residual**2) / (norm_target**2+norm_unit_scale_permuted_source**2); same log bounds; ftol1e-12, gtol1e-10, maxiter300/maxfun300/maxls50. Solver tolerances have different meanings, so achieved distances are compared directly.

refinement: Only winning grid permutation refined. Additional diagnostic refines both permutations from each branch best original-grid candidate; not a global-optimality proof.
